basis.finish_order: derived from laps completed and race time; penalties are not applied
basis.neutralisation: safety-car and virtual-safety-car messages from race control
basis.pace_laps: excludes lap 1, restart laps, pit in/out laps, safety-car, flag and suspended laps, laps excluded in lap notes, laps recorded without telemetry context, and laps without a time; laps more than 7% slower than the driver's median are hidden
basis.pit_loss: in-lap and out-lap time minus the same number of the driver's median pace laps; an estimate
basis.race_order: summed lap times; each racing segment between suspensions is summed from its own start
basis.sectors: sector bests use laps whose three sectors add up to the lap time (within 5 ms)
